validated_properties: A LaunchCapability is issued only after exact full-journal readback equals the expected prior durable bytes plus the prepared ADMIT frame.

The capability binds the durable prefix length and SHA-256, canonical ADMIT digest, reporting-admission digest, admitted-slot-set digest, deadline, block/event identity and exact historical adapter binding.

Slot preparation through the new gate rejects a missing/truncated/changed acknowledged prefix, a tampered capability, wrong block, unadmitted slot, torn current tail, closed block or different active block.
The same capability can authorize multiple admitted slots while that exact block remains active; it is stale after CLOSE.
The writer boundary is explicit: expected-before CAS, exact append, durability acknowledgement, then complete-journal readback. Speculative caller memory does not satisfy the contract.
scope: Contract harness used an injected deterministic fake adapter/framing implementation matching the bound adapter interface; the persisted gate was not byte-executed against the exact production sibling files in this environment because those repository files were not locally mountable and direct container network fetch was unavailable.
This is crash/integrity binding, not adversarial authentication. SHA-256 capability fields are not a secret MAC; a malicious caller with direct code access is outside this threat model.

The historical adapter remains immutable for replay/reproducibility and still exposes its old prepare_slot function. Enforcement is therefore structural only for callers routed through the new gate; an actual launcher must be wired to this entry point and must not bypass it.

Single-writer ordered-append model only. The DurableAppendWriter contract assumes its implementation really performs CAS plus append+fsync/durable acknowledgement plus readback; broken storage durability semantics remain out of scope.
No statistical estimator, K-guard, alpha allocation, reporting snapshot or tested-scope semantics changed in this artifact.
frontier: Byte-execute the persisted launch gate against the exact bound adapter and its production V3/K-guard siblings in a repository-local runtime, then repeat the acknowledgement-boundary crash suite without the fake adapter substrate.

Provide a concrete file/storage DurableAppendWriter and crash-inject after append-before-fsync, after fsync-before-readback, and after readback-before-capability delivery; verify exact idempotent retry and no capability from an uncertain ack.
Bind the real score-bearing slot launcher to prepare_slot_authorized so the historical prepare_slot API is not an active-runtime bypass path while preserving historical modules unchanged for replay.
Stress residual-alpha fresh-allocation and production V3 reporting snapshots across CLOSE acknowledgement and report-exposure boundaries under the launch-capability path.
Define safe migration for legacy durable journals lacking enriched reporting ADMIT metadata; never retroactively issue launch capabilities for those historical rows.
